free_tier.stated: no free tier: pay-as-you-go billed per minute, CPU VMs from $0.013/hr, the smallest `small` VM being 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 25 GB disk at $0.013/hr (~$9/month); suspend freezes a VM's state, stops billing and resumes later

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.stated: A suspended VM keeps its disk image and bills USD 0.078 per GB-month while suspended; unused credits are refundable; no deletion clock is published.
retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: Each VM has a dedicated public IP and HTTPS at <vm>.mac0.io; no egress volume allowance or price is published.

interface_detail: CLI and SSH: every operation is a CLI command with --json; machine0 ssh my-vm; HTTPS at <vm>.mac0.io.
tooling: machine0 CLI installed by https://machine0.io/install.sh; remote MCP server; NixOS or Ubuntu images.

limits.value: $0.013 an hour for the smallest VM, up to $0.208 for xxl at 8 vCPU and 16 GB
a VM stays on unless stopped or suspended; suspend freezes state and stops compute billing while image storage bills USD 0.078 per GB-month
GPUs run from $0.836 an hour up to eight H200s on one VM

limits_note: A VM stays on unless stopped or suspended; suspend freezes state and stops compute billing while image storage bills USD 0.078 per GB-month.

identity_cost.detail: Authentication is browser OAuth with a session token; funds are added through Stripe with a USD 5 minimum; the OAuth provider's identity fields are not published.
